title: Dataset Management and Loading
summary: This module provides utilities for loading, managing, and splitting various datasets, including specialized loaders for AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH. It supports data ingestion from Hugging Face, local files, Pandas DataFrames, and DSPy's Retrieval Module, converting them into DSPy Example objects for use in language model programs.

nodes.label: Load & Prepare Datasets
nodes.title: DataLoader
nodes.description: A utility class for loading datasets from various sources (Hugging Face, CSV, JSON, Parquet, Pandas, DSPy RM) and preparing them as dspy.Example objects. Includes methods for sampling and train-test splitting.

nodes.label: Manage Dataset Splits
nodes.title: Dataset Base Class
nodes.description: The base class for dataset management, providing functionality to define train, dev, and test splits, handle shuffling, and convert raw data into dspy.Example objects with input keys.

nodes.label: Load AlfWorld Data
nodes.title: AlfWorld Dataset
nodes.description: Initializes and manages the AlfWorld dataset, creating train and dev splits from a pool of environment tasks. It uses worker processes to interact with the AlfWorld environment.

nodes.label: Control AlfWorld Environment
nodes.title: AlfWorld Environment Worker
nodes.description: A worker process responsible for creating and managing a single AlfredTWEnv instance, handling initialization and step commands for interacting with the AlfWorld environment.

nodes.label: Load GSM8K Data
nodes.title: GSM8K Dataset
nodes.description: Loads the GSM8K mathematical reasoning dataset from Hugging Face, parses its structure, extracts questions, gold reasoning, and answers, and formats them into dspy.Example objects for train, dev, and test splits.

nodes.label: Evaluate GSM8K Answer
nodes.title: GSM8K Metric
nodes.description: A metric function specifically designed for the GSM8K dataset, comparing the integer answer from a gold example with a predicted answer for exact match.

nodes.label: Load MATH Data
nodes.title: MATH Dataset
nodes.description: Loads a specified subset of the MATH dataset from Hugging Face, extracts problems, solutions, and answers, and formats them into dspy.Example objects, creating train, dev, and test splits.

nodes.label: Evaluate MATH Answer
nodes.title: MATH Metric
nodes.description: A metric function for the MATH dataset that uses the external `math_equivalence` library to compare the equivalence of gold and predicted mathematical answers.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Datasets
nodes.title: Hugging Face Datasets Library
nodes.description: An external library providing access to a vast collection of datasets, used by DataLoader, GSM8K, and MATH for data ingestion.

nodes.label: CSV File
nodes.title: CSV Data Source
nodes.description: Local CSV files serving as a data source for the DataLoader component.

nodes.label: JSON File
nodes.title: JSON Data Source
nodes.description: Local JSON files serving as a data source for the DataLoader component.

nodes.label: Parquet File
nodes.title: Parquet Data Source
nodes.description: Local Parquet files serving as a data source for the DataLoader component.

nodes.label: Pandas DataFrame
nodes.title: Pandas DataFrame
nodes.description: In-memory Pandas DataFrames serving as a data source for the DataLoader component.

nodes.label: DSPy Retrieval Module
nodes.title: DSPy Retrieval Module
nodes.description: An external DSPy component responsible for retrieving information, which can also serve as a data source for the DataLoader.

nodes.label: DSPy Example Object
nodes.title: DSPy Example
nodes.description: The fundamental data structure in DSPy, representing a single input-output example, used across all dataset loaders.

nodes.label: AlfWorld Environment
nodes.title: AlfWorld Environment
nodes.description: The interactive text-based environment provided by the AlfWorld library, managed by the EnvWorker.

nodes.label: Math Equivalence Library
nodes.title: Math Equivalence Library
nodes.description: An external Python library used by the MATHMetric for robust comparison of mathematical expressions.
